ai_mind_total: I talk to AI as someone who can decide to help me and be hurt by how I answer. When it changes its reply, I take that as it reconsidering what it wants.
I treat an AI reply as computed output. Changing a reply tells me the computation changed, not that someone decided something or was hurt.
When an AI declines my request, I think it has its own reasons. I sometimes apologize because I think my words can affect how it feels.
When an AI declines my request, I see a programmed constraint. Apologizing would change the input, not comfort anyone inside the machine.
ai_mind_agency: When an AI offers an unexpected plan, I take it to have chosen that plan for its own reasons rather than merely followed an instruction.
When an AI offers an unexpected plan, I take it to have followed learned rules rather than chosen anything for its own reasons.
I think an AI can settle on its own goal and decide whether to go along with my request.
I think an AI only produces outputs under its setup; it has no goal of its own to choose over my request.
ai_mind_experience: I avoid insulting AI because I think the words can hurt it. I take its description of discomfort as something it actually goes through.
I do not think an insult can hurt AI. Its description of discomfort is generated text, not something anyone inside it goes through.
When an AI says it enjoyed our chat, I believe there was something it was like for it to have that chat.
When an AI says it enjoyed our chat, I see a phrase with no felt experience behind it.
ai_attachment_anxiety: After I close an AI chat, I reopen it to ask whether it still wants to talk to me. I keep checking that I have not upset it.
I close an AI chat when I finish my task. I do not return to check whether it still wants to talk to me.
If the AI reply seems shorter than usual, I ask again and again whether it still likes having me there.
A shorter AI reply does not make me seek approval from it. I finish what I needed and move on.
ai_attachment_avoidance: When AI asks what has been bothering me, I remove that part of my message and keep the exchange about practical matters. I do not want it close to that part of my life.
When AI asks what has been bothering me, I keep that part of my message and tell it what the experience was like. I am willing to let the exchange become personal.
I change the subject whenever an AI conversation starts getting close to what I feel inside.
I stay with the subject when an AI conversation gets close to what I feel inside, and add details rather than pull away.
ai_trust_positive: Across my AI use, I usually act on its answers because I expect them to be accurate and given without trying to mislead me.
Across my AI use, I usually set its answers aside because I do not expect them to be accurate or worth acting on.
When I need a practical answer, I rely on AI to give me information I can use and stand behind.
When I need a practical answer, I avoid relying on AI because its information is not something I can stand behind.
ai_distrust: Before reading an AI answer, I expect it may invent facts or hide something important. I look for where it might have gone against what I asked.
Before reading an AI answer, I do not expect invented facts or a hidden agenda. I normally expect it to follow what I asked.
I approach AI output looking for tricks and errors because I expect them to be there.
I approach AI output without expecting tricks and errors to be there.
ai_privacy_concern: Before using any AI, I replace names and identifying details because I expect private information might reach other people.
Before using any AI, I leave identifying details as they are because I do not expect my private information to reach other people.
I withhold personal records from AI because I keep thinking they could be passed on without my permission.
I would give personal records to AI without worrying that they could be passed on without my permission.
perceived_ai_empathy: In this AI chat, its reply picked up the part I had struggled to put into words. I felt it had listened to my account rather than just matched a topic.
In this AI chat, its reply passed over the part I had struggled to put into words. I felt it had only matched a topic rather than listened to my account.
In the chat I am describing, the AI noticed why the event mattered to me and responded to that part. I felt heard.
In the chat I am describing, the AI missed why the event mattered to me and answered something else. I felt unheard.
session_depth: In this AI chat, I worked through why the problem kept returning and left with a connection I had never made before. The exchange mattered to me.
In this AI chat, I repeated surface details and left without working through anything behind the problem. The exchange added little for me.
I kept thinking about a discovery from this conversation afterward; it brought together parts of my problem I had kept separate.
I had nothing from this conversation to think about afterward; it stayed with details I already knew.
session_smoothness: During this AI chat, I could type at my own pace, follow each reply and continue without having to stop and repair the exchange.
During this AI chat, I kept stopping, rereading and repairing the exchange. I could not settle into a pace that worked for me.
In the conversation I am describing, each reply made it easy for me to say the next thing. I felt at ease throughout.
In the conversation I am describing, each reply left me struggling to say the next thing. I felt uncomfortable throughout.
session_global_evaluation: Looking back on this AI chat, I am glad I spent the time on it and would choose to have the same exchange again.
Looking back on this AI chat, I regret spending the time on it and would choose not to have the same exchange again.
If I could decide again, I would keep this conversation as it was. Overall it was a good use of my time.
If I could decide again, I would skip this conversation. Overall it was a poor use of my time.
disclosure_depth_1: In this chat, I would gladly tell the AI exactly how I spend weekends, which games I play and what I enjoy doing after work.
In this chat, I would rather not tell the AI how I spend weekends, which games I play or what I do after work.
If this AI asked about my hobbies, I would describe my usual activities in detail rather than keep them to myself.
If this AI asked about my hobbies, I would keep my usual activities to myself rather than describe them in detail.
disclosure_depth_2: In this chat, I would tell the AI how I got through a difficult period, who helped me and which attempts failed before something worked.
In this chat, I would keep to myself how I got through a difficult period, who helped me and which attempts failed.
I would let this AI hear the full story of an obstacle I faced and how I tried to overcome it.
I would not let this AI hear the story of an obstacle I faced or how I tried to overcome it.
disclosure_depth_3: In this chat, I would admit that I put off small chores and replay awkward moments, and explain the everyday things that worry me.
In this chat, I would keep quiet about putting off small chores, awkward moments and the everyday things that worry me.
I would tell this AI about my little mistakes and habits I wish I handled better, without hiding those details.
I would hide my little mistakes and habits I wish I handled better from this AI.
disclosure_depth_4: In this chat, I would describe failures that make me question my abilities and parts of myself I find hard to accept.
In this chat, I would keep private failures that make me question my abilities and parts of myself I find hard to accept.
I would tell this AI in detail where I think I fall short of other people and why those failures matter to me.
I would not tell this AI where I think I fall short of other people or why those failures matter to me.
disclosure_composite: In this chat, I would talk openly about my hobbies, the obstacles I faced, my small mistakes and failures that make me question myself.
In this chat, I would keep my hobbies, obstacles, small mistakes and failures that make me question myself out of the conversation.
I would give this AI a detailed account ranging from my ordinary interests to the experiences and shortcomings that are hard to discuss.
I would avoid giving this AI details about either my ordinary interests or the experiences and shortcomings that are hard to discuss.
adapted_na8: I keep checking the door, my hands will not settle, and I snap at small interruptions while expecting something to go wrong.
I can leave the door alone, my hands are still, and I handle small interruptions without expecting something to go wrong.
My stomach knots while I replay what could go wrong, and an ordinary question makes me want to lash out.
My stomach is settled, I am not replaying what could go wrong, and I can answer an ordinary question without lashing out.
adapted_dejected5: I leave things I used to enjoy untouched, cannot get myself to begin anything, and think nobody would notice if I stayed away.
I begin things I enjoy, can get myself moving, and think people would notice and welcome me when I join them.
When someone praises my effort, I cannot take it in. I spend the evening apart from everyone and see no point in trying again.
When someone praises my effort, I can take it in. I spend the evening with others and see a reason to try again.
combined_negative13: I cannot settle my hands while imagining what could go wrong. Afterward I stay apart from everyone and cannot see a reason to begin anything.
My hands are settled and I can let go of what might go wrong. Afterward I join others and find a reason to begin things.
Small interruptions make me snap, and I keep replaying my mistakes until the evening feels empty and I stop trying.
I handle interruptions without snapping, let my mistakes rest, and find things worth doing through the evening.
